title: One augmented tensor comparison certifies self-Tor restriction on all resolutions
statement: Let A and B be commutative rings, I and J ideals, φ:A→B a ring homomorphism, n≥0, and q:Tor⁽ᴬ⁾ₙ(A/I,A/I)→Tor⁽ᴮ⁾ₙ(B/J,B/J) a function [def-weil-pbc-tor-modules]. Fix projective quotient resolutions P over A and Q over B. Suppose ψ:A/I→B/J is a ring map compatible with φ, a:P→Resφ Q is an augmented chain map lifting ψ, and k:P⊗A A/I→Resφ(Q⊗B B/J) sends x⊗y to a(x)⊗ψ(y). Assume that whenever cycles z,w satisfy iCycles(w)=k(iCycles(z)), the Q homology coordinate of q applied to the P Tor class of z equals homologyπ(w). Then q satisfies IsSelfTorRestrictionMap A B I J φ n q [new-t2-self-tor-restriction-certificate], with comparisons for every pair of projective quotient resolutions.

proof.text: For arbitrary P′,Q′ lift the quotient identities to u:P′→P and v:Q→Q′. Compose a with u and restriction of v; compose k with tensor u and restriction of tensor v. The augmentation and pure-tensor identities follow by composition.

Restriction of scalars preserves kernels, so the cycle image under k is a cycle of Q⊗B B/J. Naturality of homologyπ and the canonical resolution Tor coordinates identifies the class of the transported source cycle with its P′ class. Apply the given P,Q cycle equation, then the homology map of tensor v. Naturality identifies the result with the Q′ Tor coordinate. Injectivity of iCycles identifies the target cycle with w. This is implemented by the proved private helpers restrict_cycles_lift and resolution_lift_cycle_class.

lean.statement: theorem selfTor_restriction_certificate_of_resolution (A B : Type u) [CommRing A] [CommRing B] (I : Ideal A) (J : Ideal B) (φ : A →+* B) (n : ℕ) (q : (((Tor' (ModuleCat.{u} A) n).obj (ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ I))).obj (ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ I))) → (((Tor' (ModuleCat.{u} B) n).obj (ModuleCat.of B (B ⧸ J))).obj (ModuleCat.of B (B ⧸ J)))) (P : ProjectiveResolution (ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ I))) (Q : ProjectiveResolution (ModuleCat.of B (B ⧸ J))) (ψ : (A ⧸ I) →+* (B ⧸ J)) (a : P.complex ⟶ ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars φ).mapHomologicalComplex (.down ℕ)).obj Q.complex) (k : ((tensorRight (ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ I))).mapHomologicalComplex (.down ℕ)).obj P.complex ⟶ ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars φ).mapHomologicalComplex (.down ℕ)).obj (((tensorRight (ModuleCat.of B (B ⧸ J))).mapHomologicalComplex (.down ℕ)).obj Q.complex)) (hψ : ∀ x : A, ψ (Ideal.Quotient.mk I x) = Ideal.Quotient.mk J (φ x)) (ha : ∀ x : P.complex.X 0, Q.π.f 0 (a.f 0 x) = ψ (P.π.f 0 x)) (hk : ∀ (j : ℕ) (x : P.complex.X j) (y : A ⧸ I), k.f j (x ⊗ₜ[A] y) = (show Q.complex.X j from a.f j x) ⊗ₜ[B] (ψ y)) (hcycles : ∀ (z : (((tensorRight (ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ I))).mapHomologicalComplex (.down ℕ)).obj P.complex).cycles n) (w : (((tensorRight (ModuleCat.of B (B ⧸ J))).mapHomologicalComplex (.down ℕ)).obj Q.complex).cycles n), (((tensorRight (ModuleCat.of B (B ⧸ J))).mapHomologicalComplex (.down ℕ)).obj Q.complex).iCycles n w = k.f n ((((tensorRight (ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ I))).mapHomologicalComplex (.down ℕ)).obj P.complex).iCycles n z) → (Q.isoLeftDerivedObj (tensorRight (ModuleCat.of B (B ⧸ J))) n).hom (q ((P.isoLeftDerivedObj (tensorRight (ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ I))) n).inv ((((tensorRight (ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ I))).mapHomologicalComplex (.down ℕ)).obj P.complex).homologyπ n z))) = (((tensorRight (ModuleCat.of B (B ⧸ J))).mapHomologicalComplex (.down ℕ)).obj Q.complex).homologyπ n w) : IsSelfTorRestrictionMap A B I J φ n q
